children: Real estate firm Max Estates Ltd on Wednesday (September 23) said it will enter into a Joint Development Agreement (JDA) for a 9.76-acre land parcel in Indirapuram, Ghaziabad, with an estimated ₹2,500-3,000 crore gross development value (GDV) opportunity.

The proposed development has a super built-up development potential of around 1.5 million square feet. The transaction will be structured on a capital-light basis, with the landowner to be compensated through a revenue-sharing arrangement.
The proposed transaction is subject to satisfactory completion of due diligence, receipt of all requisite approvals and execution of the JDA.

The land parcel is located along National Expressway-3, with a buffer green belt, and is around 15 minutes by road from Akshardham Temple. It overlooks the green buffer zone of the Hindon River and has connectivity from both Delhi and Noida.
The proposed transaction marks Max Estates' entry into Ghaziabad, extending its NCR footprint beyond Noida, Gurugram and Delhi.
Shares of Max Estates Ltd ended at ₹599.20, up by ₹3.40, or 0.57%, on the BSE.

title: Max Estates to develop 9.76-acre Ghaziabad land parcel; eyes ₹2,500-3,000 crore GDV
